title: "Deriving redshirt status from only game-level data of select college QBs shows where the database falls short"
date: "2026-10-16"
description: "Derives redshirt status for seven QBs from game-level usage alone and shows where the database falls short: quiet usage, lower-division coverage gaps, and a duplicate roster row that breaks (playerId, season, team) uniqueness."
followups:
  - "Move the pipeline's redshirt flags onto the usage-based definition of section 2.2; stat presence over-counts (Burrow) and under-recovers (Nelson, Marchiol)."
  - "Add a (playerId, season, team) uniqueness contract to R/contracts.R; Jordan Travis carries two 2021 rows."
  - "Account for lower-division coverage gaps before building career-shape features (Ward, Chambliss)."
  - "Reconcile season totals with the game-level table: Burrow's 2016 and 2017 attempts appear in the season stats but in no covered game."

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(dplyr)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)

set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

rel_lum <- function(hex) {
  m <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex) / 255
  lin <- ifelse(m <= 0.03928, m / 12.92, ((m + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4)
  0.2126 * lin[1, ] + 0.7152 * lin[2, ] + 0.0722 * lin[3, ]
}
```

```{r}
#| label: registry
#| include: false
# Standard: key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013).
# The cfb_athlete_id here are the shared CFBD athlete namespace; each was resolved
# from the cleaned player_stats by name and QA-verified by its season/team pattern
# below; this post does not generalize the name lookup.
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who                 , ~cfb_athlete_id , ~gsis_id      ,
  "Arch Manning"       , "4870906"       , NA_character_ ,
  "Nicco Marchiol"     , "4685459"       , NA_character_ ,
  "Jordan Travis"      , "4360799"       , "00-0039797"  ,
  "Cam Ward"           , "4688380"       , "00-0040676"  ,
  "Trinidad Chambliss" , "4911529"       , NA_character_ ,
  "Joe Burrow"         , "3915511"       , "00-0036442"  ,
  "Malachi Nelson"     , "4870928"       , NA_character_
)
```

```{r}
#| label: build-spine
#| include: false
ids_sql <- paste(sprintf("'%s'", subjects$cfb_athlete_id), collapse = ",")

# Roster backbone + eligibility flags (derived table, decision 0021).
flags <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  sprintf(
    "SELECT playerId, season, team, position, class_year, has_stats,
          redshirt_season, redshirt_career, fifth_year_career
   FROM roster_flags WHERE playerId IN (%s) ORDER BY playerId, season",
    ids_sql
  )
) |>
  mutate(who = subjects$who[match(playerId, subjects$cfb_athlete_id)])

career <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  sprintf("SELECT * FROM career_summary WHERE playerId IN (%s)", ids_sql)
) |>
  mutate(who = subjects$who[match(playerId, subjects$cfb_athlete_id)])

college_picks <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  sprintf(
    "SELECT CAST(collegeAthleteId AS VARCHAR) AS pid, year, round, pick, overall,
          name, nflTeam FROM picks WHERE CAST(collegeAthleteId AS VARCHAR) IN (%s)",
    ids_sql
  )
)

# Usage: passing attempts per season from the long stats table.
attempts <- tbl(con, "player_stats") |>
  filter(
    playerId %in% !!subjects$cfb_athlete_id,
    category == "passing",
    statType == "ATT"
  ) |>
  transmute(playerId, season, attempts = as.numeric(stat)) |>
  collect()

# Game-level usage for the redshirt definition (section 2.2): regular-season
# games with any recorded statistic, and how many of each team's games the
# game-statistics table observed at all.
player_games <- tbl(con, "game_player_stats") |>
  filter(playerId %in% !!subjects$cfb_athlete_id, seasonType == "regular") |>
  distinct(playerId, season, gameId) |>
  count(playerId, season, name = "games_with_stat") |>
  collect()
covered <- tbl(con, "game_player_stats") |>
  filter(seasonType == "regular") |>
  distinct(season, team, gameId) |>
  count(season, team, name = "games_covered") |>
  collect()

teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |>
  select(team, color) |>
  collect()

# Travis's NFL record and the recruiting rows the narrative cites.
travis_nfl_rosters <- tbl(con, "nfl_rosters") |>
  filter(gsis_id == "00-0039797") |>
  distinct(season, status) |>
  arrange(season) |>
  collect()
travis_nfl_stats <- tbl(con, "nfl_player_stats") |>
  filter(gsis_id == "00-0039797") |>
  count() |>
  pull(n)
recruit_names <- tbl(con, "recruiting") |>
  filter(recruit_name %in% c("Joe Burrow", "Cam Ward", "Cameron Ward")) |>
  count() |>
  pull(n)

spine <- flags |>
  left_join(attempts, by = c("playerId", "season")) |>
  left_join(player_games, by = c("playerId", "season")) |>
  left_join(covered, by = c("season", "team")) |>
  left_join(teams, by = "team") |>
  mutate(
    games_with_stat = coalesce(games_with_stat, 0L),
    likely_rs = if_else(
      !is.na(games_covered) & games_covered >= 5,
      games_with_stat <= 1,
      NA
    ),
    # FCS/D2 programs can sit outside teams.parquet; fall back to gray.
    color = if_else(is.na(color), "#9CA3AF", color),
    flag_label = case_when(
      is.na(likely_rs) ~ "Unresolvable (under 5 covered games)",
      likely_rs ~ "Redshirt-shaped",
      TRUE ~ "Played"
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(spine) > 0,
  all(subjects$who %in% spine$who),
  !anyNA(spine$has_stats),
  # A missing attempts value should occur only on a no-stat season.
  all(is.na(spine$attempts) == !spine$has_stats),
  # A season can only be flagged when its team's games were covered.
  all(is.na(spine$likely_rs[
    is.na(spine$games_covered) | spine$games_covered < 5
  ]))
)

# One subject's seasons as a reader-facing table.
season_table <- function(name, caption) {
  spine |>
    filter(who == name) |>
    transmute(
      Season = season,
      Team = team,
      `Pass attempts` = coalesce(as.character(attempts), "none"),
      `Games with a statistic` = games_with_stat,
      `Games covered` = coalesce(as.character(games_covered), "none"),
      `Usage flag` = flag_label
    ) |>
    kable(caption = caption)
}

# One subject's seasons as bars: covered games behind, games with a
# statistic in front in team color, redshirt-shaped seasons labeled RS.
usage_fig <- function(name, title) {
  d <- spine |>
    filter(who == name) |>
    mutate(
      x = paste0(season, "\n", team),
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s %d, %s: a statistic in %d of %s covered games; %s pass attempts",
        name,
        season,
        team,
        games_with_stat,
        coalesce(as.character(games_covered), "no"),
        coalesce(as.character(attempts), "no")
      )
    )
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x)) +
    geom_col(
      aes(y = coalesce(games_covered, 0L)),
      fill = "gray88",
      width = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_col_interactive(
      aes(y = games_with_stat, fill = color, tooltip = tooltip, data_id = x),
      width = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = filter(d, flag_label != "Played"),
      aes(
        y = coalesce(games_covered, 0L) + 0.8,
        label = if_else(flag_label == "Redshirt-shaped", "RS", "no coverage")
      ),
      size = 4.6,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15), breaks = seq(0, 15, 3)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "Games with a recorded statistic (team color) out of the team's covered games (gray)",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Regular-season games"
    ) +
    theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 14) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
  girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 11, height_svg = 4.2)
}
rs_seasons <- function(name) {
  spine$season[spine$who == name & spine$likely_rs %in% TRUE]
}
```

```{r}
#| label: observability
#| include: false
gp_all <- tbl(con, "game_player_stats") |>
  filter(seasonType == "regular") |>
  select(playerId, season, team, gameId, category, statType, stat) |>
  collect()
pos_of <- tbl(con, "roster") |>
  select(playerId, season, team, position) |>
  distinct() |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    pos = dplyr::case_when(
      position == "QB" ~ "QB",
      position %in% c("RB", "FB") ~ "RB",
      position == "WR" ~ "WR",
      position == "TE" ~ "TE",
      position %in% c("OL", "G", "OT", "C") ~ "OL",
      position %in% c("DL", "DT", "NT") ~ "DL",
      position %in% c("DE", "EDGE") ~ "DE",
      position %in% c("LB", "OLB", "ILB") ~ "LB",
      position %in% c("DB", "S", "CB") ~ "DB",
      position %in% c("PK", "P", "LS") ~ "ST"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(pos), !position %in% c("?", "ATH", "PR", "KR")) |>
  # one row per player-season (duplicate roster rows, e.g. mid-season moves)
  group_by(playerId, season) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup()
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

core_all <- gp_all |>
  inner_join(pos_of |> select(-team), by = c("playerId", "season")) |>
  filter(
    (pos == "QB" & category == "passing" & statType == "C/ATT") |
      (pos %in%
        c("RB", "WR", "TE") &
        category %in% c("rushing", "receiving") &
        statType %in% c("CAR", "REC")) |
      (pos %in%
        c("DL", "DE", "LB", "DB") &
        category == "defensive" &
        statType == "TOT") |
      (pos == "ST" &
        category %in% c("kicking", "punting") &
        statType %in% c("XP", "FG", "NO"))
  ) |>
  # C/ATT is the completions/attempts composite; attempts are the numerator
  mutate(
    v = if_else(pos == "QB", as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", stat)), as.numeric(stat))
  )
# season volume, then the share of covered games with a statistic among
# full-time seasons (top volume quartile) versus the rest
season_volume <- core_all |>
  group_by(playerId, season, pos) |>
  summarize(volume = sum(v, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
stat_rate <- gp_all |>
  distinct(playerId, season, team, gameId) |>
  count(playerId, season, team, name = "games_with_stat") |>
  inner_join(pos_of |> select(-team), by = c("playerId", "season")) |>
  left_join(season_volume, by = c("playerId", "season", "pos")) |>
  left_join(covered, by = c("season", "team")) |>
  filter(!is.na(games_covered), games_covered >= 5) |>
  mutate(rate = games_with_stat / games_covered)
observability <- stat_rate |>
  filter(!is.na(volume)) |>
  group_by(pos) |>
  mutate(full_time = volume >= quantile(volume, 0.75)) |>
  group_by(pos, full_time) |>
  summarize(rate = median(rate), n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = full_time,
    values_from = c(rate, n),
    names_glue = "full_time_{full_time}_{.value}"
  )
pos_label <- c(
  QB = "Quarterback",
  RB = "Running back",
  WR = "Receiver",
  TE = "Tight end",
  OL = "Offensive line",
  DL = "Defensive tackle",
  DE = "Defensive end",
  LB = "Linebacker",
  DB = "Defensive back",
  ST = "Specialist"
)
observable <- c("QB", "RB", "WR", "LB", "ST")
```

*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-16. Careers of
recent classes (Manning, Marchiol, Chambliss, Nelson, Ward's Titans tenure)
are right-censored; later seasons may not yet be present.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

Fans describe the careers of well-known quarterbacks with confidence (a
redshirt here, a transfer there, a first overall pick), and this post turns
seven of those descriptions into statements the database should satisfy,
then checks each one, including the cases where the data cannot see the
phenomenon at all.

## 2. Data

### 2.1 Seven quarterbacks' careers are traced season by season from the roster records

The table summarizes each career and the figure lays out every roster
season in team colors, labeled with that season's pass attempts.

```{r}
#| label: s21-table
career |>
  transmute(
    Player = who,
    Seasons = seasons,
    First = first_season,
    Last = last_season,
    Schools = teams,
    Transfers = transfers,
    `Missing seasons` = gap_seasons
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Career summaries from the roster records. Missing seasons counts years between the first and last roster season with no roster row."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s21-timeline
#| fig-cap: "Season-by-season college timelines in team colors; the number is pass attempts that season and 'RS' marks a redshirt-shaped season under the rule of section 2.2. The hole in Trinidad Chambliss's row is a missing 2024, the season he won a Division II national championship at Ferris State."
p <- ggplot(spine, aes(x = season, y = who)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = color,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s, %s, %d: %s pass attempts",
        who,
        team,
        season,
        coalesce(as.character(attempts), "no")
      ),
      data_id = paste(who, season)
    ),
    color = "white",
    height = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = if_else(
        likely_rs %in% TRUE,
        "RS",
        coalesce(as.character(attempts), "-")
      )
    ),
    color = if_else(rel_lum(spine$color) < 0.5, "white", "#111827"),
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2014:2026) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 9.5, height_svg = 4)
```

### 2.2 A game-level redshirt flag is meaningful only where playing reliably produces a statistic

The table and the first figure measure how often a full-time player records
a statistic in a covered game, by position; the second figure shows the
distribution that sets the rule's threshold, and the last table states the
rule.

```{r}
#| label: s22-table
observability |>
  arrange(desc(full_time_TRUE_rate)) |>
  transmute(
    Position = unname(pos_label[pos]),
    `Full-time seasons` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * full_time_TRUE_rate),
    `Other seasons` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * full_time_FALSE_rate),
    `Seasons observed` = format(
      full_time_TRUE_n + full_time_FALSE_n,
      big.mark = ","
    )
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Median share of a team's covered games in which a player recorded a statistic. Full-time seasons are the top quarter of each position by season volume; a team-season counts as covered when the game-statistics table holds at least five of its games."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s22-explain
#| fig-height: 5
obs_plot <- observability |>
  mutate(
    Position = reorder(unname(pos_label[pos]), full_time_TRUE_rate),
    usable = pos %in% observable
  )
p_obs <- ggplot(obs_plot, aes(100 * full_time_TRUE_rate, Position)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = usable,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: a statistic in %.0f%% of covered games in a full-time season",
        Position,
        100 * full_time_TRUE_rate
      ),
      data_id = pos
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * full_time_TRUE_rate)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "#1b4f8a", `FALSE` = "gray70"),
    labels = c(`TRUE` = "Usage flag applied", `FALSE` = "Stat presence only"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = 110) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Quarterbacks and specialists show up in nearly every game they play",
    subtitle = "Share of covered games with a recorded statistic, full-time seasons",
    x = "Covered games with a statistic",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_obs, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5)
```

```{r}
#| label: s22-explore
#| fig-height: 6
obs_hist <- stat_rate |>
  filter(pos %in% observable, games_with_stat <= 15) |>
  count(pos, games_with_stat, name = "n") |>
  mutate(
    Position = unname(pos_label[pos]),
    flagged = games_with_stat <= 1
  )
p_hist <- ggplot(obs_hist, aes(games_with_stat, n)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = flagged,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %s player-seasons with a statistic in %d games",
        Position,
        format(n, big.mark = ","),
        games_with_stat
      ),
      data_id = paste(pos, games_with_stat)
    ),
    width = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Position, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "#2a6f97"),
    labels = c(`TRUE` = "One game (flagged)", `FALSE` = "Played"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "A spike at zero or one game, then genuine backup seasons",
    subtitle = "Player-seasons with at least one game with a statistic, positions where the flag applies",
    x = "Games with a recorded statistic",
    y = "Player-seasons"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 14)
girafe(ggobj = p_hist, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: s22-rule
tibble::tribble(
  ~Condition                      , ~Requirement                                                                                          ,
  "Position"                      , "Quarterback, running back, receiver, linebacker, or specialist (the positions in the figure above)." ,
  "Coverage"                      , "At least five of the team's regular-season games are in the game-statistics table."                  ,
  "Usage"                         , "The player recorded a statistic in at most one of those games."                                      ,
  "Other positions"               , "Fall back to stat presence: a season with no recorded statistic at all."                             ,
  "Fewer than five covered games" , "Unresolvable: the season is neither flagged nor cleared."
) |>
  kable(
    caption = "The usage-based redshirt rule. It is strict by design: it prefers missing a redshirt whose appearances produced statistics in two games over flagging every real backup season."
  )
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 Arch Manning's Texas career shows one redshirt-shaped season, 2023

*Expectation: playing for Texas, first in a reserve role, then becoming a
starter.* ✅

The table and figure show four Texas seasons, the first flagged
redshirt-shaped (a statistic in one of thirteen covered games) and the
next three climbing to a full starter's load.

```{r}
#| label: s31-table
season_table("Arch Manning", "Arch Manning, season by season.")
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-fig
usage_fig("Arch Manning", "From one game in 2023 to every game in 2025")
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-pin
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  identical(rs_seasons("Arch Manning"), 2023L),
  all(spine$team[spine$who == "Arch Manning"] == "Texas")
)
```

### 3.2 Nicco Marchiol's freshman redshirt is recovered, his medical redshirt is not

*Expectation: redshirting as a freshman at West Virginia, later taking a
medical redshirt there, then transferring to Northwestern.* ❌

The flag marks 2022 and the injury-shortened 2026 season at Northwestern,
while every West Virginia season after 2022 shows statistics in at least
two covered games, so no medical redshirt is visible in usage.

```{r}
#| label: s32-table
season_table("Nicco Marchiol", "Nicco Marchiol, season by season.")
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-fig
usage_fig("Nicco Marchiol", "Two quiet seasons, at either end of the career")
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-pin
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  identical(rs_seasons("Nicco Marchiol"), c(2022L, 2026L)),
  all(spine$has_stats[spine$who == "Nicco Marchiol"])
)
```

### 3.3 Jordan Travis played at Louisville, and his roster record carries a duplicate 2021 row

*Expectation: redshirting at Louisville, playing five years at Florida State
with the COVID season extending eligibility, being drafted after a
late-season injury in his final year, and never playing an NFL snap.* ❌

The season table shows 14 pass attempts at Louisville in 2018, so he did
not redshirt there even though no covered game records him, plus two 2021
rows (Florida State and Louisville) for one season; the NFL table confirms
the rest of the expectation.

```{r}
#| label: s33-table
season_table(
  "Jordan Travis",
  "Jordan Travis, season by season. Note the two rows for 2021."
)
college_picks |>
  filter(pid == "4360799") |>
  transmute(
    Draft = year,
    Round = round,
    `Overall pick` = overall,
    Team = nflTeam
  ) |>
  cross_join(
    travis_nfl_rosters |>
      summarise(
        `NFL roster seasons` = paste(
          sprintf(
            "%d (%s)",
            season,
            c(RES = "reserve list", RET = "retired")[status]
          ),
          collapse = ", "
        )
      )
  ) |>
  mutate(`NFL stat rows` = travis_nfl_stats) |>
  kable(caption = "Jordan Travis's draft slot and NFL record.")
```

```{r}
#| label: s33-fig
usage_fig(
  "Jordan Travis",
  "The 2018 attempts appear in no covered game, and 2021 appears twice"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: s33-pin
#| include: false
travis <- filter(spine, who == "Jordan Travis")
stopifnot(
  travis$attempts[travis$season == 2018] == 14,
  travis$games_with_stat[travis$season == 2018] == 0,
  sum(travis$season == 2021) == 2,
  setequal(
    travis$team[travis$season == 2021],
    c("Florida State", "Louisville")
  ),
  travis_nfl_stats == 0,
  identical(travis_nfl_rosters$status, c("RES", "RET"))
)
```

### 3.4 Cam Ward's three schools and first overall pick are confirmed, but his FCS years are thin

*Expectation: playing for three schools, then being selected first
overall.* ✅

The tables confirm three schools, two transfers, and the first pick of the
2025 draft, while the record has no 2020 season at Incarnate Word and only
47 attempts in 2021, one of the most prolific FCS passing seasons on
record.

```{r}
#| label: s34-table
season_table("Cam Ward", "Cam Ward, season by season.")
college_picks |>
  filter(pid == "4688380") |>
  transmute(
    Draft = year,
    Round = round,
    `Overall pick` = overall,
    Team = nflTeam
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Cam Ward's draft slot.")
```

```{r}
#| label: s34-fig
usage_fig("Cam Ward", "Every covered game a statistic once he reached the FBS")
```

```{r}
#| label: s34-pin
#| include: false
ward <- filter(spine, who == "Cam Ward")
stopifnot(
  n_distinct(ward$team) == 3,
  !2020 %in% ward$season,
  ward$attempts[ward$season == 2021] == 47,
  length(rs_seasons("Cam Ward")) == 0,
  college_picks$overall[college_picks$pid == "4688380"] == 1,
  recruit_names == 0
)
```

### 3.6 Joe Burrow's four quiet Ohio State seasons all look like redshirts

*Expectation: redshirting at Ohio State, then transferring to LSU and
being selected first overall.* ✅

The transfer and first overall pick are confirmed, but the flag marks all
four Ohio State seasons, including 2016 and 2017, whose 28 and 11 season
attempts appear in no covered game, against the one redshirt the
expectation implies.

```{r}
#| label: s36-table
season_table("Joe Burrow", "Joe Burrow, season by season.")
college_picks |>
  filter(pid == "3915511") |>
  transmute(

    Round = round,
    `Overall pick` = overall,
    Team = nflTeam
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Joe Burrow's draft slot.")
```

```{r}

usage_fig("Joe Burrow", "Four flagged seasons where one redshirt is expected")
```

```{r}
#| label: s36-pin
#| include: false
burrow <- filter(spine, who == "Joe Burrow")
stopifnot(
  identical(rs_seasons("Joe Burrow"), 2014:2017),
  burrow$attempts[burrow$season == 2016] == 28,
  burrow$attempts[burrow$season == 2017] == 11,
  college_picks$overall[college_picks$pid == "3915511"] == 1
)
```

*Expectation: redshirting at USC, then transferring through the portal
repeatedly.* ✅

The table shows four schools and three transfers, the most in this group,
and the flag marks the 2023 USC season (3 attempts, no covered game with a
statistic) that stat presence counts as played, plus a quiet 2024 at Boise
State.


```{r}
stopifnot(

  identical(rs_seasons("Malachi Nelson"), c(2023L, 2024L)),
```

## 4. Summary

The database satisfies most of the stated careers, and the failures sort
into three kinds: quiet usage, lower-division coverage, and a duplicate
roster row.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tibble::tribble(
  ~Expectation                                     , ~Verdict , ~`What the data showed`                                                    ,
  "Arch Manning: reserve, then starter at Texas"   , "✅"      , "Confirmed; 2023 flagged redshirt-shaped."                                 ,
  "Marchiol: two redshirts at West Virginia"       , "❌"      , "The freshman redshirt is recovered; the medical redshirt is not visible." ,
  "Travis: redshirt at Louisville"                 , "❌"      , "He threw 14 passes there; a duplicate 2021 row also appears."             ,
  "Travis: drafted after injury, no NFL snaps"     , "✅"      , "Round 5, pick 171; reserve list in 2024, retired in 2025, no stat rows."  ,
  "Ward: three schools, first overall pick"        , "✅"      , "Confirmed; 2020 missing and 2021 thin at the FCS level."                  ,
  "Chambliss: Ferris State, then Ole Miss"         , "❌"      , "Transfer confirmed; the 2024 championship season is missing."             ,
  "Burrow: redshirt, transfer, first overall pick" , "✅"      , "Confirmed, but four Ohio State seasons are flagged against one redshirt." ,
  "Nelson: USC redshirt, repeated transfers"       , "✅"      , "Four schools; usage recovers the 2023 redshirt."
) |>
  kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
Redshirt flags need a usage-based definition rather than stat presence.

- Stat presence missed Nelson's and Marchiol's freshman redshirts, which
  usage recovers.
- Usage still over-counts quiet backups such as Burrow, and it cannot see
  appearances that produce no statistic, such as Travis's 2018.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Lower-division careers are under-covered.

- Ward's and Chambliss's early seasons are missing or thin, so features
  built on career shape would read them as late starters.
- Chambliss's "missing season" is a coverage gap, not a gap in his career.
:::

Two further caveats apply: Burrow and Ward have no recruiting record, which
for Ward reflects a genuinely unranked recruit, and the duplicate 2021 row
for Travis propagates into any join on player and season.
